Case: Patient D is a 35-year-old Black man who presents to your emergency room with complaints of severe abdominal and pelvic pain. Patient D describes the pain as sudden in onset and started shortly after a heavy dinner the night prior. Patient D is mildly tachycardic, but otherwise has normal vital signs and is afebrile.
